name: Prusa CORE One
limits_source: https://www.prusa3d.com/product/prusa-core-one/ (290 C nozzle, 120 C bed, active chamber heating up to 55 C)

bed_surface.type: removable PEI spring steel sheet (smooth, satin or textured)
bed_surface.clean: Wipe the cold sheet with 90% isopropyl alcohol before prints; if adhesion still drops, a few drops of dish soap and warm (not hot) water, then dry well; acetone only on smooth PEI, about once a month.

camera.where: optional Buddy3D camera, magnet mounted in a front corner inside the chamber, IR night view

quirks.note: The CORE One pauses on chamber overheating and asks for better ventilation.

connect.notes: Gantrel has no CORE One slicing profile yet
